title: Connectedness plus a point with algebraically closed residue field gives geometric connectedness
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a connected scheme X over k possessing a point x with k algebraically closed inside its residue field is geometrically connected, and deduces the special case of a k-rational point on a connected scheme (statement lines 1081-1089). The proof takes T to be the spectrum of the residue field at x and observes that, over a separable algebraic closure, T becomes irreducible precisely because k is algebraically closed in that residue field; the geometric connectedness criterion for a connected scheme mapping to an irreducible base then gives connectedness of the base changed X, and the characterization by connectedness over the closure finishes the argument (proof lines 1091-1100). The claim is H2: three cited inputs chained in a short argument, with the algebraic closedness hypothesis used exactly at the one step where irreducibility of a point is needed.
